digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud/Data Center adapter — user identity contract
propositions: Jira Cloud uses opaque accountId for user identity while Data Center uses name, creating a leaking abstraction in assignee resolution that must be unified behind a Protocol contract.
PR #120's Data Center implementation returns authoritative=False for all assignees due to unreachable getattr-discovered attribute, causing infinite diff churn on assignee changes.

Define UserIdentityModel Protocol with resolve(local_value, remote_identity) → (value, authoritative, is_account_id) and to_payload(value) implementations for Cloud (AccountIdIdentity) and Data Center (NameIdentity).

NameIdentity must perform a real lookup against Data Center's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and converge assignee diffs, with resolver injected at construction rather than discovered via getattr.

Identity model implementations must pass a shared parameterized contract test covering all three resolution states (empty, converged, different) and a regression oracle verifying Data Center returns authoritative=True for resolvable assignees.
Unresolvable assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for both implementations rather than silently returning non-authoritative values.
